t: 西班牙人阿玛达·德·巴洛文托被由亨利·摩根船长所率领的英国私人舰队所击败.
te: the Spanish Armada de Barlovento is defeated by an English Privateer fleet led by Captain Henry Morgan.
dz: 亨利·摩根对马拉开波湖的突袭:西班牙人阿玛达·德·巴洛文托被由亨利·摩根船长所率领的英国私人舰队所击败.
de: Henry Morgan's raid on Lake Maracaibo: the Spanish Armada de Barlovento is defeated by an English Privateer fleet led by Captain Henry Morgan.

dz: 以视力不佳为理由,塞缪尔·佩皮斯在他的日记中记录了最后的事件.
de: Citing poor eyesight as a reason, Samuel Pepys records the last event in his diary.

dz: 威尼斯人将坎地亚的要塞投降给奥斯曼人,从而结束了长达21年的坎地亚围攻. 克里特会一直被奥斯曼占领到1913年.
de: The Venetians surrender the fortress of Candia to the Ottomans, thus ending the 21-year-long Siege of Candia. Crete would remain under Ottoman occupation until 1913.

te: Michał Korybut Wiśniowiecki is crowned king following the 1669 Polish–Lithuanian royal election.
dz: Michał Korybut Wiśniowiecki 在 1669 年波兰-立陶宛王室选举后加冕为国王。
de: Michał Korybut Wiśniowiecki is crowned king following the 1669 Polish–Lithuanian royal election.
